title: Staying in touch with his brothers and retirement
summary: Weekly Zoom with John and Joe; his retirement plans during Covid.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Nice. Do your brothers, do you get on the phone with your brothers and trade band stories or when you — the rare moments you’re all together?

We’re all together usually every Sunday around 1:30 and we talk on Zoom. And then we’ll pass on stuff. Or I’ll try to remember — I’ll say do you remember this, or do you remember this happening or that happening. And we’ll pass on information. We’re always talking you know, or texting. No we’re constantly in touch with each other. And Joe is not retired yet. John and I are both retired. Joe will be retiring this year. So I mean I retired not last year but the year before last, right? 2019, right? I can’t remember now. And I had the whole year blocked off. I worked in Japan, had a couple of recordings, and a couple of weeks teaching here at some summer jazz clinics. I had concerts booked. And © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
so now I’m just practicing every day with the hopes that it’s still going to happen. I think I’ve got a few more years left, how about some months?
